scope: Finite boundary events, support/germ states, signed-word identities, Boolean characteristic-function block products, composition of incidence/base-character profiles, exact signed-support evaluation and block substitution, positive antichain words, actual compensated-word identities and interval coverage, finite palette and shifted-palette cardinality bounds with transport through explicit witness recurrence and occurrence-completion hypotheses, and abstract equivariant IRT transport with finite-family iteration. The source IRT, concrete occurrence equivalence, and action laws are explicit hypotheses. The finite splitting obstruction, its preservation and reflection under expanded embeddings, the theorem that every nontrivial finite type in every unavoidable relational expansion has infinite copy and embedding big Ramsey degree, and the nonexistence of recurrent generalized big Ramsey structures remain English proofs. The support-forest constructions, local intrinsic and endpoint thickness, syndetic scalar criteria, modular recurrence, graded-monoid first-split-fibre obstruction, global prime-valuation rigidity, finite-age unavoidability without recurrence, finite dual Ramsey envelopes and relative-front completion, queue density, monochromatic affine finite-sums families, Hindman/Milliken--Taylor, interval realization, and the concrete Devlin correspondence also remain English proofs. The nonrecurrent generalized upper-bound problem remains open; no unrestricted typed Boolean Ramsey theorem is asserted.
